before.title: die of / from...
before.content: 死於（事故或疾病等）。例：The girl died from head injuries.（這女孩死於腦部創傷。）

after.content: 死於（事故或疾病等）。例：The girl died from head injuries.（這女孩死於頭部傷勢。）

patches.reason: Synchronize this one duplicate Chinese translation with the already verified head-injuries sentence. Head injuries do not necessarily mean brain injuries. Preserve the exact English, title, phrase type and existing approved status.
